subject: S5 outpost approach: original fight context versus copied level-2 route death
scope: Read-only comparison of final-week frame records, original-map position reconstruction, and existing copied-client route artifacts; no client run or gameplay change

original_observations.uncertainty: Player radar position ±2 m; target bearing ±10 degrees; range reading medium confidence; combined hostile-position uncertainty ±3.3 m horizontal, ±0.5 m vertical.
original_observations.finding: The filmed player is near (-75.74,84.21) XZ, heading about 300 degrees, with the level-1 target nameplate reading 12 m. The reconstructed target's engagement position is (-85.0,86.33,91.03), about 11.5 m horizontally from that player point. This is an engagement sample, not a proven spawn or patrol origin.

emulator_comparison.finding: The copied accepted-1995 recruit began level 2 with 8695 XP and a rifle. At (-82.2,87.2,75.2), about 16.1 m horizontally from the seeded Thrax point, the screenshot already shows an incoming -12 hit. Continued movement to (-94.5,85.2,67.5) ended in death before wounded-soldier dialogue; the server attributed the kill to the seeded Thrax at (-85,86.3,91). The original footage's level-3 shotgun combat cannot calibrate this level-2 rifle run's survivability.

emulator_comparison.exact_location: docs/evidence/bootcamp-s5-soldier-approach-20260924.json corridor checkpoint (-67.343,87.269,75.242); docs/evidence/bootcamp-d11-positions.json seeded outpost target
emulator_comparison.uncertainty: The corridor coordinate is a copied-client /loc reading; the hostile reference point is ±3.3 m and may move. Visibility and line of sight were not checked from this checkpoint.
emulator_comparison.finding: The earlier east corridor checkpoint is about 23.7 m horizontally from the seeded Thrax engagement point, before the copied route reaches the -82.2 point where damage was visible. It is a bounded place to inspect target visibility and attempt ranged engagement in a future isolated client run. It is not an original recorded player waypoint or a verified safe firing location.

decision: Do not relocate the Thrax, increase player XP, change weapon, or tune damage from this comparison. The final-week outpost fight contains an edited level-up and weapon change, while the copied route's enemy activation, sightline and combat timing remain unmeasured. The exact original approach from Youngblood to the soldier is still unverified.
next_check: In a copied-client normal-hostile run, stop at the already reached corridor point near (-67.34,87.27,75.24), inspect the Thrax target and actual line of sight before moving closer, then aim/fire while recording range, health, enemy movement and mission state. Continue to the soldier only after resolving that encounter. Treat this as emulator route testing, not a recovered original route.
source_limit: The original video file in the historical /home/blizz/backups/rasa-net/research tree is currently absent. Original observations rely on the cited verified frame records; no new footage extraction or remeasurement was possible.
